transcript.text: Hello, welcome to the On Print Shop tutorial series.
In this video, we'll walk you through the process of setting up product templates to streamline your workflow and enhance customers product customization options.
So let's get started.
First, log into your On Print Shop account.
Navigate to the left navigation panel and go to the Templates section.
Click on the Product Templates menu.
On the main screen.
You will find all the product templates created by the admin listed.
To create one, either you can click on the Add button from the top right corner or from the Master Template section you can click on the Create New version.
Let's create one product template.
To explore the features and functionalities, click on the Add button on the Add Template screen.

You need to first select the store for which you are designing this template, then specify the product type and then select the product and finally specifically the size for which you are designing the template.
Now assign the template to the template category.
You can select multiple categories here.
If you want the template to appear in the color filter results, then assign colors to the templates from the drop down or you can add new colors using the plus icon.
When the customers apply color filters on the front store, the respective templates will appear in the results.
Next, give a title to the template that will appear in the front store.
In the duplicate template, products with the size selected above will appear in the unassigned section.

If you want to save time in creating the template for the same size then you simply assign this template to any of the products by selecting the products from the list and clicking on the arrow button.
If you want to display this template in a group then you can enter a group name here.
The next setting we have is the template type.
Here you need to select if the template you are creating is customizable or not.
With this the customer will have the option to personalize the design in the designer studio.
In non customizable, the customers will have the checkout option and when selecting the product, it will be directly added to the cart.
A PDF block template when selected from the front store will open in the PDF Block studio.
For personalization.
You can select uploaded print ready PDF when you already have the design ready with you.
In PDF format, you can simply upload the design while creating the template and on the front end the customer will have the checkout option for this template.
If you are creating a template for a product with multiple pages, then with a template layout, you can define layouts for individual pages that can be used as a template.
Now, if you are creating a premium template for which you want to charge your customers, then you can enable the template cost setting from the site settings section.
Once enabled, the template cost field will be available here and you can add the cost.
When you have added the cost and when the customer browses the templates on the front store, the cost will be displayed above the customize button.
Next, we have a template personalization setting.
This setting will basically auto fill all the personalized profile blocks for the store customers, reducing the pain of entering the information again in the designer studio.
This setting is basically applicable to the private store customers, so let's skip setting this up for now.
Set the sorting for the template, enable the status as Active and click on the Save and Continue button.
This will redirect you to the designer studio for designing the product template.
You can add the elements and text as per the requirements and save the design.
This will add the template to the product template listing.
Let's check how customizable and non customizable templates will appear at the front end.
On the front end, the customizable templates will have the customize button and the templates with the checkout button will be non customizable template type or even the uploaded print ready PDF.
You can also verify the template cost added for the template here.
And there you have it.
You have successfully created product templates in your print store.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
